# pihole_dns_blocking (Resource)

Manages PiHole's global DNS blocking state (enabled/disabled). This is a singleton resource — define it at most once. Destroying it stops managing the state but leaves blocking as-is.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Manage PiHole's global DNS blocking state. Singleton — define at most once.
resource "pihole_dns_blocking" "main" {
  enabled = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether DNS blocking is enabled.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Always "blocking".
